noPermission: Only a Super Admin can access this area.
emailFailed: The notification email could not be sent. Please check the mail configuration.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.subtitle: Review organization registrations. Nobody can sign in until you approve them.
organizations.searchPlaceholder: Search by organization, owner or email

detail.auditEmpty: No decision has been recorded yet.

approve.title: Approve organization
approve.confirm: Approve "{{name}}" and let its members sign in?
approve.hint: The owner receives an "Organization Approved" email with a sign-in link.

reject.title: Reject registration
reject.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. We could not verify the business information. Please attach a business licence.
reject.reasonHint: This text is sent to the applicant by email, so make it actionable.
reject.reasonTooShort: The reason needs at least {{count}} characters.

delete.title: Delete organization permanently
delete.question: Permanently delete "{{name}}" and ALL of its data?
delete.warning: Every user, employee, role, TikTok account and shop, order, product, listing, flash sale, template, fulfillment setting, notification and log of this organization is deleted from the database. Shared platform data is not touched. Uploaded files remain on storage and are cleaned up separately.

plan.title: Plan of "{{name}}"
plan.shopLimitHint: {{count}} shops connected. Setting a lower limit is allowed: existing shops stay connected, only new connections are blocked.
plan.expiresAtHint: In your local time. Extending an expired organization re-enables it immediately; a deactivated organization stays locked until activated.
plan.invalidLimit: Maximum shops must be a whole number greater than 0.

reapprove.title: Re-approve organization
reapprove.hint: The organization becomes Approved and the owner receives the "Organization Approved" email again. An existing plan is kept; otherwise defaults apply (10 shops, expiring 30 days after registration).

deactivate.title: Deactivate organization
deactivate.hint: Admins and employees are blocked from signing in and lose access immediately (including open sessions). Data (shops, orders, products, designs, fulfillment) is kept — you can activate it again at any time.

activate.title: Activate organization
activate.hint: Admins and employees can sign in again — if the plan has not expired. The plan is not changed.

approveExpired: The expiration date is counted from the registration date and has already passed — the organization is EXPIRED. Extend it via "Edit plan".
